marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Learning Mathematics is easy and fun! With Discovering Science for Form 1, students can learn Science in an engaging and fully-interactive way ini the comfort of home. Discovering Science for Form 1 provides a comprehensive coverage of the Form 1 syllabus in English, specified in the latest curriculum issued by Ministry of Education, Malaysia. This package of CD-ROMs and activity book helps students learn from basic scientific concepts, encourages them to extend their knowledge through multimedia-enhanced enrichment activities, interactive questions and to prepares them for the examinations with specially-designed revision exercises. A friendly and easy-to-use graphical interface ensures that topic, activity or question is only a couple of mouse clicks away. A corresponding activity book is included to provide ample practices of PMR-format questions.
